sqlpipe v2.0

WARNING: Update clients that call `/v2/users` before you install v2.0. The response no longer contains the `name` field. Each user now has `first_name` and `last_name` fields. Code that reads `name` will return an error.

The new `--incremental` flag transfers only data that changed after the previous successful transfer. Use this flag for repeated transfers. The first transfer sends all selected data.

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1.x. Results can differ with the data size, schema, storage system, and available CPU resources.
